name: Flip-Flip Jigsaw Girls
description:
A new reverse puzzle game featuring adorable girls is here!
This time, traditional jigsaw puzzle gameplay is enhanced with rotation and flip-over mechanics!
Which side will you complete first? How will you orient each piece? Put your observation skills to the test in this unique puzzle experience!
Includes 15 stages in total!
As you progress, new mechanics and more puzzle pieces are introduced, increasing the challenge.

Stages 1–5: Rotation Puzzles
Stages 6–10: Double-Sided Puzzles
Stages 11–15: Double-Sided + Rotation Puzzles
Up to 81 pieces × 2 sides in the most challenging stages!

In double-sided stages, you can complete either side first—the front or the back. The choice is yours♪
The final stage offers an extreme challenge with no background watermark hints!
Take your time, carefully examine each piece, and complete the puzzle!
A gallery is unlocked as you progress, featuring both front-side and back-side illustrations.
Clear every stage and complete the entire gallery collection!
